q: When light passes from a medium to a more optically dense medium both reflection and refraction will occur for ____ angles of incidence.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light passes from a medium to a more optically dense medium both reflection and refraction will occur for all angles of incidence.

q: When light passes from a medium to a less optically dense medium refraction will occur only for ____ angles of incidence.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light passes from a medium to a less optically dense medium refraction will occur only for some angles of incidence.

q: At a certain angle of incidence, the angle of refraction becomes ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. At a certain angle of incidence, the angle of refraction becomes 90°.

q: This angle of incidence is called the ____ and is denoted by $i_c$.
e: This angle of incidence is called the critical angle and is denoted by i_c. The name used here is critical angle.

q: The light in one medium does not enter the optically less dense medium and is reflected back into the first medium for all angles of incidence greater than the critical angle, a phenomenon called ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The light in one medium does not enter the optically less dense medium and is reflected back into the first medium for all angles of incidence greater than the critical angle, a phenomenon called total internal reflection.

q: The refractive index of the medium in which the object is situated is equal to the reciprocal of the ____ of the critical angle.
e: The refractive index of the medium in which the object is situated is equal to the reciprocal of the sine of the critical angle. Sine is what this statement is using.

q: If medium $x$ is air, the refractive index is given by ____.
e: If medium x is air, the refractive index is given by _x n_y = (1)/(sin i_c). Leave the relation as _x n_y = (1)/(sin i_c).

q: A prism is a transparent object usually made of ____.
e: A prism is a transparent object usually made of glass. Glass is what this statement is using.

q: A prism has two plane surfaces, ____ to each other.
e: A prism has two plane surfaces, inclined to each other. Inclined is what this statement is using.

q: The angle $A$ is known as the angle of prism and $BC$ is its ____.
e: The angle A is known as the angle of prism and BC is its base. The name used here is base.

q: $AB$ is called the incident surface and $AC$ the ____ surface.
e: AB is called the incident surface and AC the emergent surface. The name used here is emergent.

q: The emergent ray from a prism is directed towards the ____.
e: The emergent ray from a prism is directed towards the base. Base is what this statement is using.

q: The angle $D$, between the direction of incident ray and that of emergent ray is known as the angle of ____.
e: The angle D, between the direction of incident ray and that of emergent ray is known as the angle of deviation. The name used here is deviation.

q: The angle of minimum deviation is denoted by ____.
e: The angle of minimum deviation is denoted by D_m. D_m is what this statement is using.

q: It is found that the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of emergence when the angle of deviation is ____.
e: It is found that the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of emergence when the angle of deviation is minimum. Minimum is what this statement is using.

q: By Snell's law the refractive index of the prism material is given by ____.
e: Snell's law: n1 sin θ1 = n2 sin θ2. By Snell's law the refractive index of the prism material is given by n = (sin((A+D_m)/(2)))/(sin((A)/(2))).

q: A prism having angles of $90^{\circ}-45^{\circ}-45^{\circ}$ can be used as a ____ prism.
e: A prism having angles of 90°-45°-45° can be used as a total reflecting prism. Total reflecting is what this statement is using.

q: In a total reflecting prism, ____ percent of the light is reflected.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. In a total reflecting prism, 100 percent of the light is reflected.

q: Total reflecting prisms are used in periscopes and ____.
e: Total reflecting prisms are used in periscopes and binoculars. Binoculars is what this statement is using.

q: The concept of total internal reflection is also used in cutting the faces of ____ for its brightness.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The concept of total internal reflection is also used in cutting the faces of diamond for its brightness.

q: A transparent rod in which successive total internal reflections occur is called a ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. A transparent rod in which successive total internal reflections occur is called a light pipe.

q: When a narrow pencil of white light passes through a prism, it is split into bands of different colours, which is called a ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When a narrow pencil of white light passes through a prism, it is split into bands of different colours, which is called a spectrum.

q: Splitting of white light into different colour-bands is called ____ of light.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. Splitting of white light into different colour-bands is called dispersion of light.

q: The ____ colour is deviated the most from the original path of white light.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The violet colour is deviated the most from the original path of white light.

q: The ____ colour is deviated the least from the original path of white light.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The red colour is deviated the least from the original path of white light.

q: The refractive index of the prism material for violet colour has the ____ value.
e: The refractive index of the prism material for violet colour has the largest value. Largest is what this statement is using.

q: The refractive index of the prism material for red colour has the ____ value.
e: The refractive index of the prism material for red colour has the smallest value. Smallest is what this statement is using.

q: As the angle of incidence increases, the angle of refraction also ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. As the angle of incidence increases, the angle of refraction also increases.

q: When the angle of refraction becomes $90^{\circ}$, the refracted ray lies in the ____ plane between the two media.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When the angle of refraction becomes 90°, the refracted ray lies in the boundary plane between the two media.

q: A ray incident normally on a side surface of a total reflecting prism is totally internally reflected on the ____ surface.
e: A ray incident normally on a side surface of a total reflecting prism is totally internally reflected on the hypotenuse surface. Hypotenuse is what this statement is using.

q: When a ray is reflected back along its original path by a total reflecting prism, the deviation is ____.
e: When a ray is reflected back along its original path by a total reflecting prism, the deviation is 180°. 180° is what this statement is using.

q: The concept of total internal reflection is used in cutting the faces of a diamond to enhance its ____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. The concept of total internal reflection is used in cutting the faces of a diamond to enhance its brilliance.
